result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, setIsInvalidEmail(true) is only called on validation failure; the only reset is in the cancel button's onClick. Nothing clears it on subsequent edits (MultiEmail onChange doesn't touch it) or on successful mutation (onSuccess only resets multiEmailValue and closes dialog). So the error banner persists, exactly as described.

judged_text: isInvalidEmail is set on validation failure but never cleared on subsequent input or on success, so the stale error banner persists while the user fixes the emails. A user who triggers the validation error, corrects the emails, and submits successfully sees the red 'Emails must be unique and valid' banner still displayed underneath the (now valid) fields until they cancel and reopen the dialog — confusing feedback that misrepresents the current state.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` fails, but it is never reset on subsequent `MultiEmail` edits or on mutation success. The only reset is in the Cancel button handler (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). On success, it closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`, but does not clear `isInvalidEmail`, so the error banner can remain visible after the user corrects inputs and/or when reopening the dialog.
